title: PackageReleaseState
description: REQ-105's explicit release state for a ContentPackage. All five values are declared so a later phase adds behaviour rather than a contract version, but Phase 0 can only substantiate two of them and the `package` skill refuses to emit the rest. `editorially_approved` means a named human approved the draft this package descends from and final QA passed. `rights_approved` additionally means every source asset resolves to `cleared` with evidence. `publish_ready` needs the post copy, hashtags and alt text REQ-088 also lists — REQ-054 puts those in product Phase 1 — so Phase 0 must never claim it. `published` needs a publish action, which is Stage B+ (the Phase 0 runner transitions `packaging → completed` directly and never enters `publishing`). `draft` exists for the render tier's own state and is not a package state a completed package can hold: a package IS the post-approval artefact.
